speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Overgrowth

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: The Dump is alive in all the wrong ways, but its own druids know how to make the best of it.

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Spoilage

speaker: (narration/UI)
current_text: Everything delicate rots fast in the Dump. Gourmand food does not keep. Gourmand golems keep even less.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Archdruid Compostella. Please do not look at the barn. I do not remember the barn. The barn, I am told, remembers me.
new_text: Archdruid Compostella. I am told what happened to the barn. I cannot remember doing it. I will help put it right.
writer_note: Sincere aftermath; keeps the barn and memory gap without making damage a punchline.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Ten years of the Rot in my roots. It spoke so quietly. It said I was needed. It said the whole world was waiting to grow.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: It was my own grief, wearing a seed. Thank you for helping me let it rot.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: The Dump will heal. The goat will forgive me, eventually. Plant something. Anything. It will be glad of you.
new_text: The Dump will heal. The goat may take longer to trust me. Plant something, child. Anything. It will be glad of you.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: You are carrying a loss you cannot name yet, child. When you find its name, do not bury it in a jar. Death is not the end of them.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Let it be the start of something in you.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: THE ROT-IDOL

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: It looks like the Archdruid. It is still growing. Please do not water.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: A VERY LARGE HARMLESS SHRUB

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: It used to be the Rot-Idol. Now it is topiary. Please do not water.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The Rotheart

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The Rotheart lies deep within the corrupted ecosystem, at the source of the infection. The deeper you go, the more warped the Dump's nature becomes. At the core waits the Archdruid, joined to the whole ecosystem through the Rotheart. Your HP carries in from the zone and nothing heals except on the clean soil. Beat the Archdruid to free the Verdant Dump.
new_text: At the Rotheart, the Archdruid is joined to the Dump through its corrupted roots. HP carries in from the zone; only clean soil heals you. Beat the Archdruid to free the Verdant Dump.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: The Rotheart is silent, and the roots are only roots. You can still wander the tunnels for gold and XP. HP carries in from the zone; nothing heals except on the clean soil.

speaker: (UI)
current_text: Descend into the Rotheart

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Withered Gate

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The entrance is a cracked archway wrapped in black-green vines. They tighten as you pass.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The vines part for you, slowly. They do not seem to be letting you in. They seem to be letting you go deeper.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Behind you, the gate closes with a soft, wet sound. Somewhere ahead, something very large breathes in, and the whole tunnel breathes with it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Overgrown Outskirts

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Normal-looking plants, mostly. They are a little too green. Everything is alive in a way that feels like it is watching you.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Mutant Grove

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Mushrooms the size of sheds. Some of them are looking at you. Some of them have hats.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Whispering Mushrooms

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. They know your name. They are not sure why.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A Patch of Clean Soil

speaker: (narration)
current_text: One small patch of the ordinary, honest dirt the Refusemancers love. Restore HP.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You sit on the clean soil and breathe. A thread of clear water runs through it, the only clean water you have seen down here.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It smells like rain and old compost. Somewhere underneath, a worm is minding its own business, and for the first time in a while, so are you.
new_text: You breathe in rain and old compost. Beneath you, a worm moves through the loose soil. You let your shoulders drop.
writer_note: Character-specific wording; preserves the existing beat and facts.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Spore Gauntlet

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A tunnel full of drifting spores. Whether you can walk through it depends on how well your deck has been built.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Strangler Thicket

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A tangle of vines that remembers the shape of everything that has ever walked through it.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Seed Vault

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Refusemancers' seed bank, long since overrun. Some of the seeds are still good. Some of them have opinions.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Rootbound Golem

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A golem with a ribcage of roots and a head of moss. The whole tunnel is part of its body. (Elite)

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The golem folds into the floor. The tunnel ahead is smoother, warmer, and has a pulse.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You can hear it now: a vast, slow heartbeat, shaking the walls.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Root Tunnels

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The roots have grown into the walls, the ceiling, the floor. Whatever lives here has eaten the light.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Pulsing Wall

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The wall pulses with warm, wet light. It is not entirely a wall.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Heartwood Treant

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The oldest tree in the Dump, grown into the Rotheart. It does not recognize you. It does not recognize anything. (Elite)

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: The Rotheart

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: The corrupted core of the Verdant Dump: a vast, throbbing knot of root and rot, and, at its center, a figure that was once the Archdruid.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: At the heart of the Rotheart stands Archdruid Compostella, half woman and half tree. Roots run from her arms into the floor and out into every plant in the Dump.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Her eyes are open. They are not hers.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: "I... am... THE... DUMP," she says, in many voices at once, sorrowful and enraged. "I am what you throw away. I am what grows back. I am HUNGRY."

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Beneath the many voices, one small one: "Please. The tree. I could not let her go."

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: The Archdruid sinks to her knees. The Rotheart lets out a long, shuddering breath, and across the whole Dump a thousand vines unclench.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Somewhere far above, a goat begins to eat a sign.
new_text: You hear the vines settle overhead. For a moment, nothing moves beneath your feet.
writer_note: Removes a goat-sign punchline between the Archdruid falling and her plea about the seed.

speaker: Compostella, the Rotheart, and Archdruid Compostella
current_text: "...What a terrible dream," Compostella whispers. "The seed. It is still in my roots. It will not die, and I cannot make it."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Spore Gauntlet

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Five cards drift through the spores. If enough of them are infrastructure, they will hold you steady. If not, the spores will sweeten your lungs.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Whispering Mushrooms

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A ring of pale mushrooms murmurs as you pass. "Stay," they say, in a thousand tiny voices. "Eat.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Listen. Join."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Taste a cap

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Listen to what they have to say

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Pick a few and sell them

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It tastes like rain, soil and tiny, tiny regrets. You feel strangely rested, and your tongue is a little bit blue.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: They tell you things. Where the roots run, where the Rot is thin, where the Archdruid used to walk. You hold onto what you can.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It helps. It is not entirely your own thought.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The mushrooms scream, very quietly. You pretend not to hear. A passing trader is delighted, and pays well.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The Pulsing Wall

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The wall ahead pulses with a slow, wet heartbeat. A seam runs down the middle. Behind it, warm light.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A voice inside says: "Come. Be held."

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Press your hands into the wall

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Wait beside it and breathe

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Cut a piece of it free

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The wall takes your hands, warm and wet. It hurts. Then it does not.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Roots grow along your arms, and, oddly, you feel better rooted in the world.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: You breathe in time with the wall, and it quiets. A small bit of warmth moves from the roots into you. You feel mended, and a little ashamed.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: It bleeds sap and fury. A glittering stone falls out. It is worth a lot of gold, and a bit of your arm.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: It is the seed. {villain}'s gift: life that never dies. When the great tree I grew up beneath fell, I could not bear it.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: I planted the seed in her place. It took. It has been growing in my grief for ten years. Nothing here rots, because of me.

speaker: The Wanderer
current_text: A seed that never dies isn't a gift. It's a grief that never ends. Let it rot.
new_text: It won't let you grieve. Can you let it rot?
writer_note: Short, earnest question leaves consent with Compostella; preserves let-it-rot lesson.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: Everything I ever loved, I gave back to the soil. Except this one. I could not.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: ...Then we let it die, together. Hold still. Hold me.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: I have never let go of anything so large.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: ...It is rotting. Honest compost, the first in ten years. Oh. I can hear the soil again.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: I can hear the stream. I can hear the goat.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: And I can hear her, a little, in all of it. She did not go away. She went into everything.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
current_text: To grow, I had to let her go. ...I think she has been waiting ten years for me to say so.

speaker: Brother Bramble
current_text: Nothing here has rotted in ten years. The pool is full of leaves that stay green, fruit that never softens, and a smell like a held breath.

speaker: Brother Bramble
current_text: Brother Bramble's notes are pinned to a root: 'NOTHING ROTS. NOTHING FEEDS THE SOIL. THE SOIL IS STARVING.

speaker: Brother Bramble
current_text: IT IS ALIVE. IT IS ALL TOO ALIVE. AND WHO IS EATING THE COMPOST?'

speaker: (narration)
current_text: Every tendril in the Dump runs to this one place. At its center, wrapped in roots and humming, hangs a seed the size of a fist.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: A tag in very tidy handwriting: PROPERTY OF THE PATH-OLOGISTS. LIFE THAT NEVER DIES.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: The tendrils feed on the seed, and the seed feeds on grief. Cut them, and the Rotheart will weaken.

speaker: (narration)
current_text: But the seed itself will not let go of her. And she will not let go of it.
